## What is missing?

State the gap. Two common shapes:

1. **New skill**: a language or domain reviewer that is not in
   the collection (e.g. `kotlin-code-reviewer`,
   `terraform-code-reviewer`, `svelte-code-reviewer`).
2. **New scenario prompt**: an existing reviewer skill is missing
   a prompt for a scenario the reviewer.md必查风险 lists
   without a dedicated file.

## Why does it matter?

One sentence on the production-risk blind spot this addresses.

## Sketch of the proposed content

- Skill name (if new): `kebab-case-name`
- Prompts to add: list of `<scenario>-reviewer.md` filenames
- Examples to add: list of bad/good pair filenames

## Proposer

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I have checked [README.md](../../README.md) "Skills at a Glance"
      and the "Reviewer Coverage Matrix" to confirm the gap.
- [ ] I am willing to open a PR with the new content.
